title: Hearty Sichuan Tofu Stew
description: A briny, dense stew that blends Sichuan peppercorns, allspice, and silky tofu for a nostalgic, low-glycemic comfort dish cooked on a cedar plank.
instructions: Score a cedar plank and place a sheet of parchment paper on it to prevent sticking.
In a large bowl whisk together the vegetable broth, soy sauce, fermented black soybean paste, allspice, Sichuan peppercorns, ginger, garlic, and rice vinegar.
Gently fold in the tofu cubes and sliced shiitake mushrooms, reserving a few mushrooms for garnish.
Transfer the mixture onto the prepared cedar plank, spreading it evenly.
Cover the mix with a lid or aluminum foil to create a sealed environment.
Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 45 minutes, allowing the cedar aroma to infuse the stew.
Carefully remove the cedar plank, whisk the stew to combine, and stir in sesame oil.
Serve hot, garnished with the reserved mushrooms and chopped scallions.
Enjoy a comforting, briny Sichuan tofu stew that stays low-glycemic.
